-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.ApiVocab` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem peersCtx_persistent (pv : List Peer) (ctxs : List (List w8)) : Persistent (peersCtx pv ctxs)

def AppFrom (id : w64) (st : MsgSt) : Prop :=
  st.msg.Type' = MsgApp → st.msg.From' = id

structure QMsg : Type where
  loc : Loc
  st : MsgSt

theorem mtypeOf_MsgReadIndex : mtypeOf MsgReadIndex = some MsgType.readIndex

theorem readyIdx_persistent (γr : RaftNames) (d ce es : List EntryM) : Persistent (readyIdx γr d ce
    es)

def readyOut (st : Storage) (es : List EntryM) (L : Option SnapLoan) : IProp GF :=
  match L with
  | none => appendRight st es
  | some l =>
    iprop((∃ σ, ownStorage st σ ∗ ⌜σ.pend = [] ∧ σ.fl = l.fl⌝) ∗
        storCert st (snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists))

theorem DynCCPreOp.mono_dec {d d' : CCDec} (h : DecLe d d') {D : List EntryM} {ca : Nat} {cfg :
    CCState} {op : CCOp} {k : Nat} {e : EntryM} {cs' : CCState} (H : DynCCPreOp d D ca cfg op k e
    cs') : DynCCPreOp d' D ca cfg op k e cs'

inductive RNMode : Type
  | RNMode.static : RNMode
  | RNMode.dyn (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (h1 : CCGood c0) : RNMode

def netStepTypes : List w32 :=
  [MsgApp, MsgAppResp, MsgVote, MsgVoteResp, MsgHeartbeat, MsgHeartbeatResp, MsgReadIndex, MsgReadIndexResp,
    MsgTimeoutNow, MsgTransferLeader, MsgForgetLeader, MsgUnreachable, MsgSnapStatus, MsgPreVote, MsgPreVoteResp, MsgSnap]

theorem SentMsgOk.ne_timeoutNow {st : MsgSt} (H : SentMsgOk st) : st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgTimeoutNow

def sentTypes : List w32 :=
  [MsgProp, MsgApp, MsgAppResp, MsgVote, MsgVoteResp, MsgHeartbeat, MsgHeartbeatResp, MsgReadIndex, MsgReadIndexResp,
    MsgPreVote, MsgPreVoteResp, MsgSnap]

def ccPropArg (γ : RaftNames) (o : ConfChangeIM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ bs,
      ⌜MarshalsConfChange (some o) bs⌝ ={⊤}=∗
        ⌜Filler (confChangeEntryType (some o)) bs⌝ ∨
          ∃ Q,
            propIs γ (entKey (confChangeEntryType (some o)) bs) Q ∗
              □?γ.dup propAu1 γ (entKey (confChangeEntryType (some o)) bs) Q)

def RespType (t : w32) : Prop :=
  t = MsgAppResp ∨ t = MsgVoteResp ∨ t = MsgPreVoteResp

def HsEmpty (hs : HardStateM) : Prop :=
  hs.Term' = W64 0 ∧ hs.Vote' = W64 0 ∧ hs.Commit' = W64 0

def msgAbs (st : MsgSt) (a : Option Msg) : Prop :=
  mtypeOf st.msg.Type' = none ∧ a = none ∨
    (∃ ty, mtypeOf st.msg.Type' = some ty ∧ ty ≠ MsgType.snap ∧ a = some (absMsg ty st.msg st.ents st.ctx)) ∨
      ∃ sv,
        mtypeOf st.msg.Type' = some MsgType.snap ∧
          st.snap = some sv ∧ a = some (absSnap st.msg sv sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists)

def NetMsgOk (id : w64) (st : MsgSt) : Prop :=
  st.msg.Type' ∈ netStepTypes ∧
    (¬UnstampedType st.msg.Type' → st.msg.To' = id ∧ st.msg.Term' ≠ W64 0 ∧ st.msg.From' ≠ W64 0) ∧
      (UnstampedType st.msg.Type' → st.msg.Term' = W64 0) ∧
        (st.msg.Type' = MsgApp ∨
              st.msg.Type' = MsgHeartbeat ∨
                st.msg.Type' = MsgHeartbeatResp ∨ st.msg.Type' = MsgReadIndexResp ∨ st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap →
            st.msg.From' ≠ id) ∧
          (st.msg.Type' = MsgAppResp → st.msg.Reject' = true → st.msg.From' ≠ id) ∧
            (st.msg.Type' = MsgTransferLeader → st.ents = [] ∧ st.ctx = []) ∧
              (st.msg.Type' = MsgPreVote → st.msg.From' ≠ id) ∧ st.resps = []

def msgDat (γ : RaftNames) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ ∀ sv, ⌜st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap ∧ st.snap = some sv⌝ -∗ snapDataOk γ sv.Metadata'.Index' sv.Data')

theorem SentMsgOk.of_msg {st st' : MsgSt} (H : SentMsgOk st) (hm : st'.msg = st.msg) (hr : st'.resps
    = []) (hna : st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgApp) : SentMsgOk st'

def isRaftMsg (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜γ.reNoSnap = true → st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgSnap⌝ ∗
      ⌜γ.reNoXfer = true → SentMsgOk st⌝ ∗
        (∃ a, ⌜msgAbs st a⌝ ∗ [∗list] x ∈ a.toList, isMessageC γ x) ∗ msgDat γ st ∗ ⌜st.resps = [] ∧ AppFrom id st⌝)

def RNMode.isDyn : RNMode → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | RNMode.static => false
  | RNMode.dyn dec c0 h0 h1 => true

def instDecidableRespType (t : w32) : Decidable (RespType t) :=
  id inferInstance

structure SnapLoan : Type where
  ptr : Loc
  snap : SnapshotM
  fl : w64
  dlv : List EntryM
  decs : DecMap

inductive Pending : Type
  | Pending.self (pv : Bool) (t : w64) : Pending
  | Pending.appendAck (term : w64) (base : entryID) (last : Option entryID) (sn : Option SnapshotM)
      : Pending
  | Pending.applyAck (ents : List EntryM) : Pending

def propEntryM (d : List w8) : EntryM :=
  { Term' := W64 0, Index' := W64 0, Type' := W32 0, Data' := d }

def ready_countable : Pos.Countable Ready :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun r =>
      (r.SoftState', r.HardState', r.ReadStates', r.Entries', r.Snapshot', r.CommittedEntries', r.Messages', r.MustSync'))
    (fun p =>
      { SoftState' := p.fst, HardState' := p.snd.fst, ReadStates' := p.snd.snd.fst, Entries' := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        Snapshot' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, CommittedEntries' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        Messages' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, MustSync' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    ⋯

def bootInit (γ : RaftNames) (md : RNMode) (id : w64) (V : GSet w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) : IProp
    GF :=
  match md with
  | RNMode.static => ownRaftGhost γ id (bootPState bootLog)
  | RNMode.dyn dec c0 h0 h1 =>
    iprop(⌜γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0) ∧ c0 = cfgState V ∅⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhostR γ dec c0 id (rboot c0 bootLog))

theorem NetMsgOk.of_sent {dst : w64} {st : MsgSt} (H : SentMsgOk st) (Hto : st.msg.To' = dst) (Hnp :
    st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgProp) : NetMsgOk dst st

def snapReceipt (st : Storage) (l : SnapLoan) (es : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownSnapM l.ptr (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) l.snap ∗
      ∃ σr,
        ownStorage st σr ∗
          ⌜σr.prev = snapId l.snap ∧
              σr.ss = snapId l.snap ∧
                σr.ents = es ∧
                  σr.pend = [] ∧
                    σr.fl = l.fl ∧
                      σr.scs = l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists ∧
                        σr.sal = l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave' ∧ σr.sdat = l.snap.Data'⌝)

theorem SentMsgOk.ne_transferLeader {st : MsgSt} (H : SentMsgOk st) : st.msg.Type' ≠
    MsgTransferLeader

def bootMarshal (ps : List w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (bootLog : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ k p dq m e x Φ,
        ownConfChange p dq m -∗
          (∀ d, ownConfChange p dq m -∗ ownSlice d e.Data' (DFrac.own 1) -∗ Φ (intoVal d, intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal (functions google_golang_org.protobuf.proto.Marshal []))
                (intoVal (interface.mkOk raftpb.ConfChange.ty.PointerType (intoVal p))))
              {{ Φ }})

def SentMsgOk (st : MsgSt) : Prop :=
  st.msg.Type' ∈ sentTypes ∧
    st.msg.From' ≠ W64 0 ∧
      (st.msg.Type' = MsgProp ∨ st.msg.Type' = MsgReadIndex → st.msg.Term' = W64 0) ∧
        (¬(st.msg.Type' = MsgProp ∨ st.msg.Type' = MsgReadIndex) → st.msg.Term' ≠ W64 0) ∧
          (st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgReadIndex →
              st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgVoteResp →
                st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgPreVoteResp →
                  (st.msg.Type' = MsgAppResp → st.msg.Reject' = true) → st.msg.From' ≠ st.msg.To') ∧
            (st.msg.Type' = MsgApp → AppShape st) ∧ st.resps = []

def AppShape (st : MsgSt) : Prop :=
  st.msg.Vote' = W64 0 ∧
    st.msg.Reject' = false ∧ st.msg.RejectHint' = W64 0 ∧ st.snap = none ∧ st.ctx = [] ∧ st.resps = []

theorem NsCap_persistent (ns : Bool) (st : Storage) : Persistent (NsCap ns st)

def NsCap (ns : Bool) (st : Storage) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ (⌜ns = true⌝ -∗ storCap st 1))

def rnInit (γ : RaftNames) (md : RNMode) (id : w64) (V : GSet w64) : IProp GF :=
  match md with
  | RNMode.static => ownRaftGhost γ id initPState
  | RNMode.dyn dec c0 h0 h1 =>
    iprop(⌜γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0) ∧ c0 = cfgState V ∅⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhostR γ dec c0 id (rinit c0))

def ConfigValid (cv : Config) : Prop :=
  cv.ID' ≠ W64 0 ∧
    cv.ID' ≠ W64 18446744073709551615 ∧
      cv.ID' ≠ W64 18446744073709551614 ∧
        (0 < sint.Z cv.HeartbeatTick' ∧ sint.Z cv.HeartbeatTick' < sint.Z cv.ElectionTick') ∧
          cv.Storage' ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧
            0 < sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' ∧
              (cv.MaxInflightBytes' = W64 0 ∨ uint.Z cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≤ uint.Z cv.MaxInflightBytes') ∧
                cv.Logger' ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧ (cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 ∨ cv.CheckQuorum' = true)

def stTks (γ : RaftNames) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  if st.msg.Type' = MsgProp then [∗list] e ∈ st.ents, entTk γ e else iprop(emp)

theorem bootMarshal_persistent (ps : List w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (bootLog : List EntryM) :
    Persistent (bootMarshal ps ctxs bootLog)

theorem isRaftMsg_dat [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (st : MsgSt) :
    isRaftMsg γ id st ⊢ msgDat γ st

def advReceipt (st : Storage) (es : List EntryM) : Option SnapLoan → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => appendReceipt st es
  | some l => snapReceipt st l es

theorem NoConfIn_prefix {D F : List EntryM} {lo hi : Nat} (hp : D <+: F) (hhi : hi ≤ D.length) (h :
    NoConfIn D lo hi) : NoConfIn F lo hi

def softStateRO (p : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = null⌝ ∨
      ∃ lead rs,
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef SoftState go!"Lead" p) lead DFrac.discard ∗
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef SoftState go!"RaftState" p) rs
            DFrac.discard)

theorem isRaftMsg_pers (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (st : MsgSt) : Persistent (isRaftMsg γ id st)

theorem softStateRO_persistent (p : Loc) : Persistent (softStateRO p)

def peersCtx (pv : List Peer) (ctxs : List (List w8)) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] p;ctx ∈ pv;ctxs, ownSlice p.Context' ctx DFrac.discard

def readyDq (st : MsgSt) : DFrac :=
  if RespType st.msg.Type' then DFrac.own (Qp.half 1) else DFrac.own 1

theorem msgDat_pers (γ : RaftNames) (st : MsgSt) : Persistent (msgDat γ st)

def readyIdx (γr : RaftNames) (d ce es : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L,
      lastRec γr L ∗
        ⌜L < 2 ^ 64 ∧
            (∀ (e0 : EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑es.length ≤ L + 1) ∧ ↑(d ++ ce).length ≤ L⌝)

def UnstampedType (t : w32) : Prop :=
  t = MsgReadIndex ∨ t = MsgTransferLeader ∨ t = MsgForgetLeader ∨ t = MsgUnreachable ∨ t = MsgSnapStatus

structure RNState : Type where
  delivered : List EntryM
  unpersisted : List EntryM
  steps : List Pending
  term : w64
  storage : Storage
  outlb : Nat
  unst : Bool
  clb : w64
  tc : w64
  mode : RNMode
  cfg : CCState
  capplied : Nat
  flw : Bool
  psnap : Bool
  slent : Option SnapLoan
  phs : HardStateM

theorem NetMsgOk.resps {id : w64} {st : MsgSt} (h : NetMsgOk id st) : st.resps = []

def DynCCPreOp (dec : CCDec) (D : List EntryM) (ca : Nat) (cfg : CCState) (op : CCOp) (k : Nat) (e :
    EntryM) (cs' : CCState) : Prop :=
  ca ≤ k ∧
    k < D.length ∧
      D[k]? = some e ∧
        IsConfEnt e ∧
          NoUndecConfIn dec D ca k ∧
            (∃ op', dec (List.take k D) e = some (CCDecision.apply op') ∧ ccStepB op' cfg = some cs') ∧
              ccStepB op cfg = some cs'
